Ellipsoids

Source: R/layers-glyph.R
geom_ellipsoid_3d.Rd

Draws one solid ellipsoid per row, centred on x, y, z. Give either the semi-axes rx, ry and rz, turned by an optional rotation (a list-column of 3 x 3 rotation matrices whose columns are the directions of the three semi-axes), or sigma, a list-column of symmetric positive semidefinite 3 x 3 shape matrices: the ellipsoid is then the set of points p with (p - centre)' sigma^-1 (p - centre) <= 1, as in rgl's ellipse3d() at t = 1. For a covariance matrix and a confidence level, scale sigma by qchisq(level, 3). All lengths are in the scale-transformed units of the position axes, and the ellipsoids expand the position scales.

Usage

geom_ellipsoid_3d(
  mapping = NULL,
  data = NULL,
  stat = "identity",
  position = "identity",
  ...,
  detail = 2L,
  axes = FALSE,
  shade = TRUE,
  na.rm = FALSE,
  show.legend = NA,
  inherit.aes = TRUE
)

Arguments

mapping, data, stat, position, ..., na.rm, show.legend, inherit.aes

Standard layer arguments.

detail

Subdivision level of the icosphere, from 0 to 6.

axes

Whether to draw the three principal axes of each ellipsoid as opaque segments through its centre, in the colour aesthetic or, where that is missing, the fill darkened by half. Inside an opaque ellipsoid they are hidden; give the ellipsoids an alpha below one to see them.

shade

Whether to apply lighting.

Value

A ggplot2 layer.

Details

Each ellipsoid is an icosphere of 20 * 4^detail triangles stretched onto the principal axes; in curvilinear frames it is placed at its mapped centre and keeps its shape.

See also

stat_ellipsoid_3d() estimates the ellipsoids from groups of points; geom_sphere_3d(), geom_glyph_3d().

Examples

d <- data.frame(x = c(0, 3), y = c(0, 1), z = c(0, 1), rx = c(1, 0.5),
                ry = c(0.5, 0.5), rz = c(0.3, 1.2))
ggplot2::ggplot(d, ggplot2::aes(x, y, z = z, rx = rx, ry = ry, rz = rz)) +
  geom_ellipsoid_3d(fill = "steelblue") + coord_3d(aspect = "data")

groups <- split(iris[1:3], iris$Species)
e <- data.frame(t(sapply(groups, colMeans)), species = names(groups))
names(e)[1:3] <- c("x", "y", "z")
e$sigma <- lapply(groups, function(g) cov(g) * qchisq(0.95, 3))
ggplot2::ggplot(e, ggplot2::aes(x, y, z = z, sigma = sigma, fill = species)) +
  geom_ellipsoid_3d(alpha = 0.6, axes = TRUE) + coord_3d()
